pages.text: A Salvegleam is an Arcane Gem formed from a pink-spectrum piece of $(l:arcanearchives:items/shapedquartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$(/l) in an asscher cut.$(br2)When held and toggled on, the gem will heal you for half a heart approximately once every second if you are hurt. Each half heart consumes a point of charge.
Salvegleams can be crafted on a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/gemcutterstable)Gem Cutter's Table$(/l).
